evals.prompt: 我有个叫 report-builder 的 skill，现在只输出诊断式的检查清单，用户看完还得自己动手。帮我给它加一个 'Fix Suggestions' section，放在输出格式那节后面，给每个 error 级的检查项配一条具体修复步骤。路径是 skills/report-builder
evals.expected_output: Enhancement plan showing: 1) a new 'Fix Suggestions' section inserted after the Output Format section, 2) content in imperative style with rationale where the rule is non-obvious, 3) line budget math showing SKILL.md stays under 500 lines, 4) an insert-only diff with no pre-existing lines modified

evals.prompt: skills/data-validator 里校验逻辑散落在各个 phase，我想补一个 agents/schema-checker.md，专门负责确认输出是否符合 schema。别动现有的东西，只加这个 agent 和指向它的那一行
evals.expected_output: Enhancement plan showing: 1) a new agents/schema-checker.md with the standard agent structure (role, task, inputs, output format, criteria), 2) one conditional pointer added in SKILL.md with a 'when to load' condition, 3) the agent file is self-contained and does not require reading SKILL.md, 4) diff contains only inserts

evals.prompt: skills/changelog-writer 的重写步骤缺 examples，用户看不出 before/after 到底差在哪。帮我补 2-3 个具体例子，展示从 MUST 式命令改成讲清理由的写法。路径 skills/changelog-writer
evals.expected_output: Enhancement plan showing: 1) examples added to the relevant step, 2) each example is a before (MUST-style directive) and after (rationale-based) pair, 3) realistic and under 30 lines in total, 4) line budget check for the 500-line target, 5) no duplication of examples that already exist elsewhere in the body
